## Natural history notes

A medium-sized dragonfly characterized by a bright red body in mature males, reddish wing bases, and a broad flattened abdomen, while females and young individuals are more yellow-brown with a pale stripe along the abdomen. In Florida, the Scarlet Skimmer is an introduced species found around ponds, lakes, canals, ditches, marshes, stormwater basins, and other still or slow-moving waters with open sunny edges. Adults perch conspicuously and hunt flying insects from low vegetation, while the aquatic nymphs live among submerged plants and debris where they prey on small aquatic animals.
